name: Open chassis
thesis: A personal workbench becomes a tactile machine interface, with enormous controls that reveal the things Raygen makes.
interaction: Project selector paddles change the machine on the platen; an orange actuator removes SERV0's panels or reveals DAVID and Stardance notes.
why: Vermilion cast surfaces, actual assemblies, and physical-feeling controls turn Raygen's love of making into the way his site behaves.
